why_not_integrated.conclusion: vegetation layers answer 'are there trees here?', not 'what niche is this?'. Predicting where trees CAN grow from where they DO grow is circular, and the advantage vanishes on exactly the cleared land an afforestation advisory has to rank.
why_not_integrated.permitted_use: filters on model output, and diagnostics

landcover.name: ESA CCI Land Cover PFT v2.0.81
landcover.epoch_limit: published to 2020 only. No credential-free land-cover product runs past 2022: Copernicus Global Land needs a VITO account, MODIS and VIIRS need NASA Earthdata. So land cover CANNOT match 2015-2024 as tightly as NDVI does; 2020 at least falls inside the window.

ndvi.name: PKU GIMMS NDVI V1.2
ndvi.epoch_note: 2021-2022; the source ends in 2022, so this covers 8 of the 10 years of the 2015-2024 climate window
ndvi.role: filter and diagnostic only -- circular as a predictor

soilmoisture.name: ESA CCI Soil Moisture v09.2 COMBINED
soilmoisture.epoch_note: 2015-2024, matching the climate window in full
soilmoisture.role: microwave, not greenness -- the only legitimate predictor candidate here, left unintegrated by decision; reaches only ~79% of occurrence points, with gaps under dense canopy
